run_fused_topk_bias: run fused_topk_bias to compute top-k expert routing with correction bias for softmax or sigmoid scoring
create_FusedTopKBiasRouter: create a FusedTopKBiasRouter with top_k, num_experts, eplb_state, and correction bias for MoE routing
call_FusedTopKBiasRouter_compute_routing: call _compute_routing on FusedTopKBiasRouter with hidden states and router logits to get top-k weights and ids
use_vllm_topk_softmax: use vllm_topk_softmax to compute top-k softmax routing weights and indices with correction bias
use_vllm_topk_sigmoid: use vllm_topk_sigmoid to compute top-k sigmoid routing weights and indices with correction bias
